//: Build profiles for EAS (Expo Application Services).
EXPO_PUBLIC_* values are BAKED INTO THE BINARY at build time — an app on
someone's phone cannot be re-pointed at a different server afterwards.
Getting this wrong means a new App Store submission to fix, which is why
each profile names its API URL explicitly instead of relying on a local
Replace API_URL_PLACEHOLDER in the preview and production profiles with
the real deployed API URL once it exists (see render.yaml).
Build:   npx eas build --profile production --platform ios
Submit:  npx eas submit --profile production --platform ios

preview.//: TestFlight / internal testers. Points at the real API.

production.//: App Store. Must point at the production API.
